Ability_Gwynplaine1_description: Gwynplaine hurls his cursed chain scythe in a line, latching onto the first enemy struck, dealing 100/165/230/295 Magic Damage and pulling them toward him.
Ability_Gwynplaine1_description_simple: Target a position to throw your chain scythe, dealing ^o{90,150,210,270} Magic Damage^* and ^oHooking^* the target, dragging them to Gwynplaine's location.\r\n\r\n^gStaff of the Master:^* Increases hook range by 15% (to 920).
Ability_Gwynplaine1_IMPACT_effect: Deals 100/165/230/295 Magic Damage and pulls target to Gwynplaine.
Ability_Gwynplaine2_description: With eerie, supernatural momentum, Gwynplaine glides forward across the shadows, fluttering his crimson-lined coat, dealing 80/140/200/260 Magic Damage, Perplexing enemies for 0.5 seconds, and slowing them along his path.
Ability_Gwynplaine2_description_simple: Target a position to glide across shadows, dealing damage, slowing, and Perplexing enemies passed through.
Ability_Gwynplaine2_IMPACT_effect: Deals 80/140/200/260 Magic Damage, slows enemies by 20/25/30/35% for 2.5 seconds, and Perplexes for 0.5 seconds.
Ability_Gwynplaine3_description: Passive: Gwynplaine gains 4/8/12/16 bonus Agility. Each basic attack inflicts crippling trauma, stealing 2/3/4/5 armor and granting bonus armor to Gwynplaine for 4 seconds.
Ability_Gwynplaine3_description_simple: Passive: Grants bonus Agility. Gwynplaine's attacks steal armor from enemy targets.
Ability_Gwynplaine3_FRAME_effect: +4/8/12/16 Agility. Attacks steal 2/3/4/5 Armor for 4 seconds.
Ability_Gwynplaine4_description: Gwynplaine impales an enemy hero with his scythe in a burst of maniacal laughter, dealing 300/450/600 Superior Magic Damage plus 25/30/35% of missing Health, stunning for 1.0/1.25/1.5 seconds.
Ability_Gwynplaine4_description2: ^gThis ability can be boosted by Staff of the Master.^*\r\n\r\n^gStaff Effect:^* If The Final Punchline delivers the fatal blow to an enemy hero, its cooldown is immediately refreshed. In addition, Runic Tether's hook range is increased by 15% (from 800 to 920).

Also increases Runic Tether hook range by 15% (to 920).
Ability_Gwynplaine4_IMPACT_effect: Deals 300/450/600 Superior Magic Damage plus 25/30/35% missing Health and Stuns for 1.0/1.25/1.5 seconds.

Hero_Gwynplaine_description: A macabre showman of the Hellbourne whose grotesque permanent grin conceals relentless, sadistic cunning. Wielding a hooked scythe attached to heavy iron links, Gwynplaine turns the battlefield into a bloody spectacle.
Hero_Gwynplaine_role: Gwynplaine is an elusive melee assassin and initiator who hooks priority targets, glides through enemy formations to perplex them, strips armor with sadistic glee, and executes weakened prey with a devastating punchline.
